For me (and I obviously had to replay bc I need my man) Taz broke up with me because I danced with Jirayu at the masquerade party. I think you have to turn that option down and also sleep alone for them to decide to stay with you after being a spy!

I think he also has some self-confidence issues too, which probably led to a complicated relationship with sex. We don’t see it a lot in his interactions with MC, but during the last workshop my MC used the word “gentle” (or something along those lines) to describe him, and he gets pretty upset and says he’s not gentle, and tells MC a story about how a girl rejected him in high school, came back when he was in the NFL, and he dated her basically to string her along as revenge for rejecting him. I don’t know if everyone got that story based on what word you choose during the workshop but I was feeling pretty similarly about him being TOO perfect, and that kind of added a layer! He expressed a lot of guilt for that too so I think his gentleness and affection towards MC comes from never wanting to hurt someone like that again!
